title: Port session watch-store source identity and conditional release
scope: Complete watchSessionStores and its sessionStores ownership over shared readonly arrays of store handles. Preserve container/member identity, ordering/duplicates, conditional old cleanup and fresh empty arrays after successful release. No subscription calls in this unit.
acceptance: Full pinned activity module compares array/member identity and cleanup states before Rust, including same-content distinct arrays and old cleanup after reconfiguration.
Dropped cleanup does not release; borrowed opaque store handles and every previous native corpus remain required.
open_items: watchSession subscriptions, plugin busy store registration and full engine session wiring remain separate.
Readonly owned arrays exclude arbitrary mutable JS array/getter/prototype behavior; actual browser runtime remains required.
